tests.reason: Sending a code, confirming it and removing a number write to the shared production database and send a real SMS, so none of it runs on staging (rule 48). The off switch, the missing-secret refusal, normalisation, the country list, test/service-account refusal, the number-in-use checks, every limit verdict, every confirm verdict, the Auth write and the routes are proven by Jest with a mocked SMS sender; the migration (atomic one-challenge upsert, limits, attempts, expiry, privileges, the auth → profile → link → unlink chain, NULL-safe e-mail rule, concurrency) is proven on a throwaway local Postgres by docs/validation/VTID-05095/migration-test.sql (outputs/migration-test.txt). The signed-in read of GET /api/v1/me/phone (enabled:false while the switch is off) is in the VTID-05096 community-app staging spec.
